threshold_note: The expensive pass produces counts.csv, which is THRESHOLD-INDEPENDENT. Labels in sequences.csv are a cheap derivation on top. scripts/relabel_corpus.py regenerates them under different thresholds in seconds, without re-running the detector -- so a threshold decision is a config change, never a reason to delay building the corpus.
